newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOODY'S RAISES DAINIPPON SCREEN DEBT RATING TO BA1.
newsitem.headline: MOODY'S RAISES DAINIPPON SCREEN DEBT RATING TO BA1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service Inc said on Thursday it had raised Dainippon Screen Manufacturing Co Ltd's long-term unsecured debt rating to Ba1 from Ba3.

The upgrade reflects Dainippon Screen's strengthened competitive position in the world semiconductor manufacturing equipment market and improved cost structure resulting from its restructuring measures, Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's also said that it believes that Dainippon Screen will continue to improve its debt protection measurements in the intermediate term.
Moody's also said that the restructuring should enable the company to more quickly adjust to cyclical downturns and rapid technological changes in the semiconductor manufacturing equipment market.
